title: Tests leave upload files behind in node-bot/tmp
body:
`node-bot/tmp` has about 900 leftover files with hex names. They come from tests that exercise uploads and write into the real tmp folder instead of a temporary one.

Find which tests write there, and make them use a directory from `fs.mkdtemp(os.tmpdir())` (passed in the same way the code already allows, or through a small option if it doesn't). Clean it up after each test. Don't delete the existing leftover files; I'll clear those myself. Add a check that running those tests leaves `node-bot/tmp` unchanged.
interface: The upload tests (mobile-routes, plugin-input-hooks-routes, server-routes, transcribe-partial-*, voice-upload-cleanup) still pass and leave node-bot/tmp unchanged.
why: One of my live failures: she has to find every test that writes uploads and give it a temp folder, not just patch one.
